dct_description_sm: We did this meta-analysis to better understand the structure of abundance of wildlife species and its implications in forecasting models of wildlife response to climate change. The selection of beaver as a model species was made upon data availability and quality. We have used this dataset to model the response of beavers to a warmer climate using thermal niche modelisation. Wildlife response to climate change should be heavily dictated by the structure of abundance across a species range and the largest change may occur in regions of transition between high and low abundance. This suggests that range expansion studies might not represents the major ecological effects of climate change and that major changes may happen in areas far away from a species current distribution limits.
dct_title_s: Aerial surveys of beaver abundance across Quebec
